relationships.evidence_quote: Lack of HAP1 obviously suppressed mechanical allodynia and hyperalgesia in spared nerve injury (SNI)-induced and chronic constriction injury-induced pain.

relationships.subject: HAP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Its deficiency also greatly inhibited the excitability of nociceptive neurons.

key_findings: HAP1 is upregulated in dorsal horn and DRG in acute and chronic pain, and HAP1 deficiency suppressed SNI- and CCI-induced mechanical allodynia and nociceptor excitability.
HAP1 suppression reduced Cav1.2 membrane expression and SNI-induced astrocyte and microglia activation.
